description: This file contains functions and API calls for managing system services using procd, including service lifecycle, configuration, signaling, and validation, with external dependencies on libubox and ubus.

methods.name: procd_open_service
methods.description: Initializes a new service with optional script.

methods.name: procd_close_service
methods.description: Sends the command message for the service.

methods.name: procd_open_instance
methods.description: Adds an instance to the current service.

methods.name: procd_running
methods.description: Checks if a service/instance is currently running.

methods.name: procd_kill
methods.description: Kills a service instance or all instances.

methods.name: procd_send_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to a service instance.

methods.name: procd_status
methods.description: Gets the status of a service/instance.

methods.name: procd_open_data
methods.description: Opens a data object for a service.

methods.name: uci_load_validate
methods.description: Loads and validates a configuration section, optionally calling a callback.
